name: What are the key steps in a ground-up commercial construction process?

mainEntity.name: What are the key steps in a ground-up commercial construction process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The commercial construction process typically begins with pre-construction planning, which includes site assessment, feasibility studies, design development, and securing necessary permits. Following this, the physical construction phases involve site preparation (clearing, grading), foundation work, structural framing, exterior enclosure, and interior finishes. The project concludes with inspections, commissioning, and final handover to the client. Throughout each stage, Opus Builders ensures meticulous attention to detail and adherence to quality standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key steps include pre-construction planning, site preparation, foundation work, structural framing, exterior enclosure, interior finishes, and final inspections.
